title: Finite etale pullback equivalence implies finite constant H1 comparison
statement: Let $i:Y_0\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose base change along $i$ is an equivalence between their categories of finite etale schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. For every finite abelian group $M$, the map $H^1(Y,\underline M)\to H^1(Y_0,i^*\underline M)$ of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] is bijective, where $\underline M$ is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. No henselian, properness, or closed-fibre hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0A5G (lemma-proper-over-henselian-and-h1), categorical implication in the last paragraph, using Tags 03AJ and 03RV; only the implication from finite etale equivalence is extracted

proof.text: Choose inverse-image torsors τT with their sheaf isomorphisms and action equations by [lem-sc-etale-torsor-h1-functoriality]. The same theorem gives cohomologyMap i (classH1 T) = classH1 (τT). The source and target canonical classH1 maps are equivalences by [thm-galois-torsor-h1].

Write two source cohomology classes as classH1 of quotient representatives. If their pullbacks agree, naturality and injectivity of target classH1 identify the transported torsor quotient classes. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-torsor-reflection] to reflect the resulting torsor isomorphism. Source classH1 then gives equality of the source classes.

Write a target cohomology class as classH1 of a target torsor R. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-torsor-lifting] to find T with τT isomorphic to R. Its source class is a preimage by naturality and equality of the target torsor quotient classes. The codomain throughout is the inverse-image coefficient sheaf.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A5G final paragraph; geometric reflection and lifting split off, with the cohomology assembly proved using the existing sheaf torsor classification and inverse-image functoriality
